resources.string: Blocks screen touches during calls to prevent accidental video call button presses

■ Basic Usage (Basic mode)
When making or receiving a call, tap the side tab button on the right edge to expand it, then tap "Start".
When the ShieldTap badge appears at the bottom-right, touch blocking is active.

■ Turn Off
Tap the ShieldTap badge to turn off touch blocking; the side tab button reappears.

■ Move the Side Tab
Long-press the side tab button — the border brightens and it enters move mode.
Drag left/right or up/down to place it where your thumb reaches easily. (Left-handed users can move it to the left edge.)

■ Plus Mode (Automatic)
In Plus mode, touch blocking turns on automatically when a call connects and off when it ends. No side tab action is needed.
If you turn it off manually during a call, it won't re-activate for that call; it resumes automatically on the next call.

ShieldTap prevents unintended screen touches during phone calls.

■ Accessibility Service
Required to display the touch-blocking overlay on screen.
Does not read or collect any screen content.

■ Call Detection (Plus)
Detects call connection and disconnection to automatically enable and disable the blind.
Does not access phone numbers or call content.

■ Battery Optimization Exemption
Prevents some manufacturers (Samsung, etc.) from force-stopping the background service.

■ Privacy
ShieldTap does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information.
No internet permission is used.
